_instructions: Fill this in by watching annotated.mp4. Set labelled=true when done. Frame numbers refer to the working video (outputs/<clip>/work.mp4); metadata.json records the offset back to the source video.
_active_play_help: Inclusive [start_frame, end_frame] ranges where a rally is actually in progress. The >=90% two-player tracking target is measured over these frames only, because coverage between rallies is not what the criterion is about.
_missed_hits_help: Frames of real hits the pipeline did not detect at all: [{"frame": 123}]
_hits_help: One row per detected hit. Set is_real_hit=false for a false positive. Correct true_hitter to 'near' or 'far' where the assignment is wrong.
_rallies_help: Set boundary_ok=true/false for each detected rally.
